metadata.description: AI-powered secure development workflow for healthcare software. RePPITS methodology with HIPAA, SOC2, and HITRUST gates.

plugins.name: reppit-health
plugins.description: Run /reppit for the full Research → Propose → Plan → Implement → Test → Secure workflow with healthcare compliance gates, or invoke any phase as a standalone slash command. /secure runs HIPAA, SOC2, and HITRUST checklists against your diff and separates code-verifiable findings from organizational controls.
